## Gate triggers

- **Reviewer Finding 2 (stale)**: reviewer reported missing test file — but tester had already created it. Reviewer ran in parallel and checked an earlier state. Gate B was actually passing; no action needed.
- **Reviewer Finding 1 (B1 — BLOCKER)**: `List-Unsubscribe` derived from `MAILER_FROM` domain instead of `props.unsubscribeUrl`. Fix: read `req.props?.unsubscribeUrl`, wrap in `<...>`. Aligns with RFC 8058 (pairs with SES adapter's `List-Unsubscribe-Post`). Tests updated.
- **Reviewer Finding 3 (B3 — BLOCKER)**: `MAILER_FROM` absence threw plain `Error` breaking project error pattern. Fix: `MailSenderError({ code: 'MISSING_CONFIG', ... })`.

## Test gate

✓ vitest gate passed — 136 tests (26 new), 12 test files, 0 failures.
Gate A: `npx vitest run` exits 0.
Gate B: `src/sender/index.ts` covered by `src/sender/index.test.ts` (colocated).

## What shipped

`src/sender/index.ts` — `createMailSender(router, logWriter)` returning `{ send }`. The pipeline: `renderTemplate` → `router.resolve` → read `MAILER_FROM` → assemble `ProviderSendRequest` (with `List-Unsubscribe` for promotional/update using `props.unsubscribeUrl`) → `adapter.send` → `logWriter.writeSendAttempt` (best-effort, swallowed on failure) → return `SendResult`. Exports `SendRequest`, `MailSenderError` (codes: `TEMPLATE_ERROR | SEND_LOG_ERROR | MISSING_CONFIG`), `isMailSenderError`, `SendLogWriter`, `WriteSendAttemptArgs`.

## What didn't ship

The Send Log write path is a stub interface (`SendLogWriter`) — the real Postgres implementation is WU-006. The integration acceptance criterion (real SES deliver + log persistence) requires WU-006 to be complete.

## Decisions / open questions / risks filed during this run

- **List-Unsubscribe format**: `<https://url>` (angle-bracket-wrapped HTTPS URL) to pair with SES adapter's `List-Unsubscribe-Post: List-Unsubscribe=One-Click` per RFC 8058. Implicit in D008; no new decision file required but noted here.

## Notes / observations

Parallel tester+reviewer timing caused the stale "missing test file" false blocker — reviewer checked before tester wrote the file. This is expected when running them concurrently. The two real blockers (header value source, error type) were caught cleanly by the reviewer and fixed in one retry pass.
